name: english-spanish-web-localization
title_zh: 同一处文案，按访客地域自动换英式、美式
tagline_zh: 给网站、App、简历做本地化，不再一套英文走天下。en-GB、en-US、es-ES。
tagline_en: Localize websites, apps, CVs properly—not one English fits all. Four regional variants checked line by line.
desc_en: Plan, execute, audit, and QA contextual English–Spanish localisation among British English (en-GB), US English (en-US), Spanish for Spain (es-ES), and Latin American Spanish (es-419). Use for websites, apps, portfolios, CVs, Markdown, documentation, repositories, locale catalogues, CMS exports, accessibility, and terminology systems; not for certified translation.
why_zh: 把本地化拆成计划、执行、审计、QA 四步，自带术语系统和可访问性检查，不是简单替换单词。
why_en: Four-step pipeline: plan, execute, audit, QA. Built-in terminology system and accessibility checks. Rewrites context, not word.
limit_zh: 只覆盖英语与西班牙语的地区变体，不做认证翻译；需要人工审校的合同、法律文书等正式文件不适用。
limit_en: Only English and Spanish regional variants; not for certified translation. Legal or contractual documents needing human review are out of scope.
title_en: One copy, auto-switched for en-GB, en-US, es-ES, es-419.
